text:
Sam_Sales: Kicking off POC with Orion Financial — they need EU data residency, a signed DPA, SOC2 artifacts, and a scoped pen-test. Quick alignment?
Alex_SE: 👍 high level: chat-based Q&A + embeddings for doc search + reranker. We should scope evals and sample prompts.
Mike_Eng: They expect ~40M tokens during the 2-week trial window (peak). Also asked about latency SLOs and cost per 1k tokens for dedicated capacity.
Leah_Security: List from security side: DPA exec, SOC2 Type II redacted report, KMS integration details (they require customer-managed keys), and pen-test scope + timeline. Confirm whether PHI is in scope — customer claims no PHI but will have transaction PII (GDPR).
Sam_Sales: Customer asked whether we can do a short Dedicated reservation rather than pay-as-you-go for predictability. They want a pro-rated option and SLA for 99th pct latency.
Alex_SE: For POC ops I'd recommend: Hosted endpoint with dedicated pool (burst) or a 2-week Dedicated trial on 1 GPU class. Success metrics we should propose: 
```
- 99th percentile response time < 350ms for 512-token context
- Retrieval precision @10 > 0.78 on their eval set
- Cost target: <= $0.45 per 1k prompt tokens (POC target)
- End-to-end integration: embeddings + rerank latency < 500ms
```
Sophia_Product: We also need quality guards: sample prompt set (500 queries) + golden answers for eval, plus automated regression alerts. Can Alex draft the prompt set?
Alex_SE: I'll assemble 500 prompts across three buckets (FAQ, transaction lookup, policy exceptions). Example prompt from the set:
```
User: "Find the latest status for invoice #12345 and any flagged anomalies. Include confidence score."
System: <expected JSON with fields: status, anomalies, confidence>
```
Leah_Security: Pen-test asks: they want both external app scan and auth flow review. If we do Hosted, provide public IP ranges and short vulnerability scan. If Private (VPC), they'll coordinate an internal scanner — need contact. Also request for redacted pen-test report from other customers if available.
security-bot: SOC2 report link (redacted): https://redwood.internal/sec/soc2-2025-redacted (access request via Okta). DPA template: https://redwood.internal/legal/dpa-template.pdf
Sam_Sales: Timeline proposal: Week 0: sign DPA + access; Week 1: infra + sample prompts + ingest; Week 2: run evals & tune; End of Week 2: final review + decision. Pen-test to run after Week 2 if they want full scan (can be parallel but may extend timeline).
Mike_Eng: Can we get KMS key rotation docs and a quick how-to for customer-managed keys? They insisted on CMK for logs and embeddings.
Leah_Security: Yes — provide KMS integration doc and helplink for on-prem/private key setup. Also need to confirm logging retention — they asked for 90-day audit logs.
Alex_SE: Action items: 
- Alex: draft 500-prompt eval + example responses (due in 2 business days)
- Leah: prepare SOC2 redacted copy & DPA sign instructions (due EOD tomorrow)
- Sam: send pricing options (Hosted burst vs 2-week Dedicated pro-rate) + draft SOW
- Mike: prepare KMS integration + logging retention note
Sam_Sales: I'll loop in legal for expedited DPA exec. Any blockers from security?
Leah_Security: No blockers if DPA + SOC2 doc + KMS plan provided. Pen-test scheduling may add 1 week to timeline depending on scope.
Sam_Sales: Great — I'll update Orion with the timeline and action items. Will post a short follow-up once Alex and Leah upload docs. :thumbsup:
